scope: CPU binary64 research experiments; empirical errors and timings are not uniform floating-point certificates.
notes: Final paired runs use identical 61 physical queries and 25 synchronized timing repetitions.
Earlier ablations use 42 plan-specific queries; their largest errors are not directly paired domain samples.
Final coefficient matrices use batches of 16 query seeds; earlier ablations before final_comparison use one batch.
Missing stable_factors, separate_grids, and common_queries flags in early configs mean false.
Original output paths identify experiment batches; all results are consolidated in this file.
